versions.changelog:
- Added troubleshooting guide at references/troubleshooting.md for error-handling and debugging integration issues.
- Removed the skill-card.md file.
- Minor updates to documentation and references to reflect the new troubleshooting resource and simplify guidance.

Initial release of querit-api skill for integrating with Querit.ai web search and content extraction APIs.

- Provides guidance for integrating and debugging code using Querit.ai's /v1/search and /v1/contents endpoints.
- Includes authentication instructions and minimal usage examples in Python using both the official SDK and REST.
- Details how to choose appropriate endpoints and request parameters for common use cases.
- Explains common error scenarios (401/403/429, empty results) and best practices for troubleshooting.
- Lists required environment variable (QUERIT_API_KEY) and compatibility notes for scripts and library usage.
